summary:
新思科技 EPS 大幅低於預期 72.78%（$0.09 vs $0.33），但營收年增逾 41.9%，盤後微漲 0.29%，EDA 一次性費用或業務組合調整造成利潤異常，需進一步觀察。
• EPS $0.09 遠低於預估 $0.33，驚喜幅度 -72.78%，為本批次最大 EPS 落差，異常顯著。
• 單季營收 $22.76 億美元，年增幅高達 41.9%，顯示 EDA 工具與 IP 業務需求強勁，與 EPS 大幅落差形成矛盾。
• 本益比 104 倍，市值 $869 億美元，高估值意味市場預期長期盈利能力遠高於本季表現。
• 盤後股價微漲 0.29%，未因 EPS 大幅低於預期而下跌，顯示市場認為本季異常或一次性費用影響。
• 41.9% 年增率強勁但 EPS 嚴重低於預期，兩者落差反映費用面存在重大一次性或非經常性項目。
ai_view:
新思科技本季呈現高度異常的財報格局：41.9% 的強勁年增率搭配 EPS -72.78% 的巨大驚喜落差，兩者並存通常暗示存在重大一次性費用或會計調整（如收購相關費用、重組成本、或業務組合重分類）。盤後微漲 0.29% 說明市場目前傾向將此視為一次性事件而非結構性惡化。然而在無法確認費用性質之前，104 倍本益比與低迷 EPS 組合形成的估值風險不應被低估。短期而言，EPS 異常帶來不確定性，建議觀望等待管理層對費用性質的說明（雖本批次數據中無法取得）；中期而言，若下季 EPS 恢復至 $0.30 以上水準且年增率維持，當前股價具正當性。追蹤指標：次季 EPS 是否回歸正常區間、一次性費用是否真正不重複、EDA 工具授權合約成長動能。本季財報為「高不確定性」類型，需額外謹慎。

需留意：EPS 大幅低於預期 72.78%，若非純屬一次性費用而是業務獲利能力下降，104 倍本益比面臨嚴重修正風險。；EDA 軟體市場高度集中（新思科技與益華電腦），監管層面若審查 EDA 出口或合併案，將影響業務發展。；104 倍本益比在 EPS 大幅落差後難以用當季數字支撐，需未來季度 EPS 快速回升才能維持估值水準。

summary_en:
Synopsys missed EPS by 72.78% ($0.09 vs $0.33 expected) despite 41.9% YoY revenue growth; the flat post-earnings reaction and 104x P/E suggest the EPS miss may reflect one-time charges rather than structural deterioration.
• EPS of $0.09 missed the $0.33 estimate by 72.78%—the largest EPS shortfall in this batch and a significant negative outlier.
• Revenue of $2.28B grew 41.9% YoY, a strong top-line result that contradicts the EPS miss and suggests one-time expense items.
• P/E of 104x on an $87B market cap reflects long-term profitability expectations well above this quarter's depressed EPS.
• Post-earnings stock edged up +0.29%, confirming the market attributes the EPS miss to non-recurring charges rather than business deterioration.
• The stark gap between 41.9% revenue growth and -72.78% EPS surprise strongly implies significant one-time costs or restructuring charges.

ai_view_en:
Synopsys presents the most anomalous result in this batch: 41.9% YoY revenue growth paired with a -72.78% EPS miss is a configuration that almost always indicates significant one-time charges (e.g., acquisition-related costs, restructuring, or business reclassification) rather than operational deterioration. The +0.29% post-earnings move confirms the market's tentative 'one-time event' interpretation. However, at 104x P/E, the risk of multiple compression is acute if any portion of the EPS miss reflects structural margin decline. Near-term, the earnings anomaly creates uncertainty; await management clarification on the nature of charges before adding exposure. Medium-term, if next-quarter EPS rebounds to the $0.30+ range and growth remains above 30%, the valuation is defensible. Key metrics to monitor: next-quarter EPS normalization, confirmation that expense items are non-recurring, and EDA tool license growth momentum. This is a 'high uncertainty' result requiring additional caution.

Watch：A -72.78% EPS miss is highly abnormal; if any portion reflects structural margin erosion rather than one-time charges, the 104x P/E is at severe risk of compression.; The EDA software market is a near-duopoly (Synopsys and Cadence); any regulatory scrutiny on EDA exports or merger reviews could disrupt business plans.; At 104x P/E, the stock's valuation cannot be supported by this quarter's $0.09 EPS; sustained re-acceleration of earnings is essential to maintain the current multiple.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期 EPS 實際 $0.09 遠低於預估 $0.33，驚喜幅度 -72.78%，為本批次最大 EPS 落差，需關注是否為一次性因素。
